title: Update Log/Version 1.47.0
body:
This page contains all the changes made in Version 1.47.0.

Official update log

Added

  • Some cake and balloons are available in the Oak Depot! They will be available for a limited time of 2 weeks (Jan 28 US Time). Get them while you can!

Changes

  • Added Anniversary Cake and Anniversary Balloons to the limited-time shelf in the Oak Depot.
